projects.title: Invoice Management Desktop App
projects.description: A desktop invoicing application built for a family business to replace manual billing. Generates invoices, manages customer records, and stores all data locally using SQLite, allowing the business to operate without an internet connection or cloud dependency.

projects.title: SazDrive
projects.stack: React · Node.js · Express · TypeScript · JWT · Supabase · PostgreSql · Prisma
projects.description: A cloud storage application inspired by Google Drive with file uploads, folder management, and user authentication. Users can organize and manage their files through a familiar interface while all metadata, relationships, and access controls are handled through a PostgreSQL-backed API.

projects.title: Personal Blog Site
projects.stack: React · Node.js · Express · JWT Auth · TailwindCSS
projects.description: A full-stack blogging platform featuring a public-facing blog and a separate admin dashboard for content management. Includes authentication, post publishing, commenting, and a REST API built with Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Baki - React Native Mobile App
projects.description: A mobile credit and payment tracker built for a small business. Tracks who owes what, records transactions, and keeps a running balance per customer. Designed primarily to be simple enough that a non-technical shop owner could use it daily without training.
